rationale_one_line: RLM's whole story is a number (a small model recursing over its own context beats a much bigger one at the same cost), so RECEIPT lets the metric carry the praise, and the vercel brand pack gives the clean engineered-infrastructure register that fits a drop-in inference library while clearing the last-14 anti-repeat window where every preset is spent.
writing_tone_notes: Build-in-public peer voice. Confident, plain, a little understated. The inversion does the bragging. Specifics over adjectives. Short declaratives. Contractions where natural. Let the numbers and the recursion loop prove the claim instead of superlatives.
do_rules: Lead the receipt scenes with the +34 points at same cost result.
Show the recursion as a loop the model spawns on itself, not a longer window.
Frame the novelty as a one-line drop-in swap, not a new framework.
Close on the inversion reframed from the fix, not repeated.
dont_rules: No version numbers anywhere in copy.
No phrase repeated across the tweet, the Why-this-one, and scene copy.
No em dashes, semicolons, question marks, arrows, or colons in body lines.
